timeline.current_model: The INS gene's susceptibility to type 1 diabetes (IDDM2 locus) is mechanistically linked to VNTR minisatellite alleles in its promoter region: class III alleles drive higher insulin mRNA expression in the thymus (facilitating central immune tolerance) but slightly lower expression in fetal pancreas compared to class I alleles, with transcriptional activity further modulated by G-quartet DNA structure formation at the ILPR; fine mapping localizes the causal variant(s) to a ~2-kb region containing the VNTR, -23HphI, and +1140A/C polymorphisms.
